info.title: airlock
info.description: Run an AI coding agent inside a disposable Windows Sandbox, with the target project as the only writable host folder.

commands.name: create
commands.description: register a folder as an airlock without opening it

arguments.name: FOLDER
arguments.description:
the folder to register; defaults to the current directory
Switches:

commands.name: list
commands.description: every airlock, and whether it is open right now

commands.name: open
commands.description: open this folder as an airlock and run a tool in it, or a shell

arguments.name: TOOL
arguments.description:
the tool to run, and its arguments
Switches:

commands.name: remove
commands.description: unregister one by name or folder; it stays mounted until stop

commands.name: start
commands.description: bring the sandbox up with every configured tool and airlock

commands.name: stop
commands.description: destroy the sandbox; --force stops one it cannot prove is its own

options.name: --force
options.description: stop a sandbox even if Airlock cannot prove it started it

commands.name: tools
commands.description: list, add or remove the read-only mounts that land on PATH

options.name: --project
options.description: the folder to open; defaults to the current directory

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: show what would be mounted and exit without starting anything

arguments.name: VERB
arguments.description:
open | start | stop | list | create | remove | tools | connect
Switches:
